data.one_liner: A Flutter package to display a customizable circular countdown widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides a circular countdown widget that can be used for various units like days, hours, seconds, or points. It supports static display, built-in timer countdown logic, and controlled countdowns.
use_when: You need to display a circular countdown timer in your UI
You want to track remaining time or units visually in a circle
avoid_when: You do not need a visual circular progress or countdown representation
strengths: Easy to set up with built-in time countdown logic
Highly customizable size, colors, stroke width, and gaps
Supports null safety and multiple platforms
weaknesses: Controlled countdown requires an external library (timer_controller)
